title: Interface Abstraction
definition: A concept that refers to the representation and interaction of components within a system through a well-defined interface, abstracting the complexities and details of the underlying components.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine a car dashboard. It's simple to use, with buttons and displays that perform specific tasks without needing to understand all the mechanics of the car engine.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: In the context of the backup system, the GUI can be considered an abstraction that allows users to interact with the backup process using a well-defined interface, abstracting away the complexity of the underlying file operations.
difficulty_levels.expert: The GUI is a form of interface abstraction that enables user-friendly interaction with complex systems. It not only simplifies usage but also improves maintainability by providing a clear separation between the user interface and the underlying system, as changes to the system do not necessarily need to be reflected in the user interface.
